response.sql: SELECT tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist, AVG(sf.shortintrt) as avg_short_interest, AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_option_volume_ratio, CASE WHEN AVG(sf.shortintrt) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE AVG(sf.shortintrt) / (SELECT AVG(sf2.shortintrt) FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf2 JOIN transactionrecord tr2 ON sf2.transref = tr2.transreg WHERE tr2.ordertypedist = tr.ordertypedist) END as ratio FROM transactionrecord tr INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON sf.transref = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
